player_prompt.intro:
E te tagata ta'aalo {player_id} i se {num_rounds}-tausaga o IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
I le tausaga ta'itasi, fa'amaonia se numera i le va o {min_guess} ma {max_guess}.
Ina ua mae'a uma fa'amaonia, o le target o (2/3)x(averesi o fa'amaonia uma),
ma o le tagata ta'aalo e latalata i le target o le toa o le tausaga lea.
Tali mai ma lau fa'amaonia i le ituaiga '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid format; please submit your guess as “[<number>]”.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O le fua e tatau ona i le va o {min_guess} ma {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Tagata ta'aalo 0 na fa'amaonia {guess0}; Tagata ta'aalo 1 na fa'amaonia {guess1}. O lea la, o le Target o: {target}.
message.round_draw: E leai se iʻuga o le taamilosaga.
message.round_win: O le tagata taalo {winner} ua manumalo i le taaloga!

outcome.p0_wins: Na manumalo le tagata taalo 0 i nisi o taaloga.
outcome.p1_wins: Na manumalo le tagata taalo muamua i nisi o taaloga.
outcome.draw: O le taaloga atoa e tutusa.
